items.text: Plan tab shows content after load, never blank
Summary screen renders, never black
Primary button is 64dp tall and full width minus 16dp
Every tappable is at least 48dp
Effort prefilled from the last working set, dotted
Log stays disabled with "Pick an effort" when no effort and none prefilled
Warm-ups show no effort chips and never start rest
Font scale 1.3: numerals scale, nothing truncated, Log visible
Font scale 2.0: effort chips wrap to two rows
Set pills show done, now, next, warm-up
No checker baseline increases
Rest primary uses RestCyan and says Start set N now
Rest ring done turns Volt with holdDone haptic
Tempo sheet opens only when next target changes
Using Tempo can be undone within the undo window
After the last planned set, What next sheet opens
Between lifts shows next lift and keeps rest running
Finish blocked while a correction is open
Summary shows sets, volume, PRs; Tempo card only on change
Today primary is Start workout with day and lift count
Preview Begin creates exactly one session
Plan day save handles back with unsaved edits
Past session uses one When field
Cardio Finish enabled only after 60 s
History detail shows warm-ups marked W and effort hint
All strings on touched screens come from strings.xml ids
